ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a circle, and points A, C, and B are all on the circumference. From point B, connect respectively to A and C, forming two chords BA and BC. The inscribed angle at point B is labeled 24°, and this angle is composed of BA and BC, and the intercepted arc is arc AC. Reasoning: According to the inscribed angle theorem, the measure of an inscribed angle is equal to half the measure of the arc it intercepts. Therefore m arc AC = 2 × 24° = 48°.
